# Santiago Olayo Villamil (santiago-jv)

> Senior Software Engineer (Backend, Cloud, Product Analytics & AI Internal Tooling) and Product Owner Engineer based in Colombia (Barranquilla / Santa Marta, working remotely for international companies). 4+ years of experience building and scaling production systems at GoodRec and Bolsiyo.

## Core Technical Stack & Capabilities
- **Backend & Languages:** Node.js, NestJS, TypeScript, Java, Spring Boot, LoopBack 4, Express.js, JavaScript (ES6+), SQL, REST APIs, GraphQL
- **Software Architecture & Distributed Systems:** Hexagonal Architecture (Ports & Adapters), Domain-Driven Design (DDD), Clean Architecture, Microservices, Atomic Distributed Locks (Redis), Event-Driven Architecture, Asynchronous Queues
- **AI Internal Tooling & LLM Governance:** Contributed to migrating manual team processes to AI-assisted workflows; improving and maintaining internal MCP (Model Context Protocol) tooling to connect services with preferred LLMs, evolving team-specific plugins and skills across internal work areas, and maintaining prompting rules with Cloudflare AI Gateway
- **Cloud, Serverless & DevOps:** AWS (Lambda, EC2, S3, RDS, SQS, CloudWatch), Google Cloud Functions, Cloudflare AI Gateway, Docker, GitHub Actions, CI/CD pipelines
- **Databases & Persistence:** PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis, MySQL, database schema design, production migrations, query optimization
- **Observability & Product Analytics:** Datadog (APM, Distributed Tracing, service monitoring, alerting, incident investigation), CleverTap (product event tracking & business metrics), Metabase (data analysis & product decision support)
- **Product & Engineering Leadership:** End-to-end feature ownership across Product, Operations, Support, and Finance; stakeholder management, technical design, code reviews, Scrum/Agile
